name: Igasud Studio
role: Deterministic Simulation Engine & Autonomous AI Lab
about: Igasud Studio is an independent deep-tech simulation laboratory engineering high-throughput, web-native game simulation engines. We pioneer Component-Material Data Abstractions (CMDA) decoupled from traditional OOP constraints, bridging deterministic local reinforcement learning with Anthropic Claude's cognitive orchestration for emergent multi-agent ecosystems directly in the browser.
